items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Oscar and I, we became very friendly, and we used to meet whenever we can

ctx.x: Now, when you met -- you met Pettiford on 52nd Street. Did you meet him like after he played or after you played or did you meet him in a social setting?

I met him -- he was playing in a little spot down the street. He was playing with another group, and I met a lot of the fellows on the Street, you know. And we -- Oscar and I, we became very friendly, and we used to meet whenever we can -- we could, rather -- around the corner at our favorite hangout. The White Rose Bar, you know, a lot of musicians used to hang out there, and it was our meeting place, you know, where we used to get together, have a drink or two and chat and talk about our music and where we'd…
And the street was really quite a place.
